title: dde's Amazing Mod
description: Adds new blocks, items, potions, and small gameplay features focused on fun building, utility tools, and lighthearted content.
body:
This mod adds new blocks, items, and potions to Minecraft. It is meant to be a small content expansion that keeps the game familiar while giving players more things to build with and experiment with.

## Content

### Blocks

- Cool Block, Cool Stairs, Cool Slab
- Poop Block, Poop Stairs, Poop Slab, Poop Wall, Poop Fence, Poop Fence Gate, Poop Door, Poop Button, Poop Pressure Plate
- Suspicious Cake (a cake that gives you random effects)
- Die Block (a block with a random 50/50 chance to destroy or duplicate your items)

### Items

- Suspicious Substance (ingredient)
- Cord Lat (food)
- Poop Piece (food)
- Anti-Cooked Beef (food that removes hunger instead of restoring it)
- Day Wand (turns the world into day time)
- Three music discs with custom songs

### Potions and Effects

- Long Arms potion effect
- Giant potion effect
- New brewing recipes to craft these potions
